title: An's 30-Day Challenge
segments: An loved working at 'The Daily Brew'. The smell of coffee and fresh pastries made her happy every day. One morning, her boss, Mr. Chen, called her to his office. 'An,' he said, 'I want to make you the new manager. But first, you must learn our new online ordering system in 30 days.'

After that, An went to a computer in the office. She found the website for the new ordering system. She created an account with her email and a strong password. The system then asked for her phone number to set up two-factor authentication. She entered it, feeling confident about her 30-day challenge.

The next day, An took a break. She sat at her favorite table with a glass of lychee tea and her phone to study the new system. Suddenly, her hand slipped and she spilled water all over her phone! The screen went black. An gasped. She couldn't get the login code now!

Because of this, An felt a wave of panic. She couldn't get the login code from her broken phone. How could she finish her training now? Her promotion was in danger! She knew she had to tell Mr. Chen what happened, but she was so worried he would be angry with her.

Then, An told Mr. Chen everything. He wasn't angry at all. "Accidents happen," he said with a kind smile. He showed her a backup recovery option on the login page. An used it to reset her account with her email. Finally, she was logged in! She could continue her training.

After that, An studied the new system every day. She felt so relieved and thankful for Mr. Chen's help. The problem with her phone was scary, but she learned an important lesson about asking for help. At the end of the 30 days, she knew the system perfectly. Mr. Chen was very proud.
endWrap: An got the promotion to cafe manager! She was excited to start her new role, feeling confident and ready for any new challenges that might come.
